verdict.rationale: Dashboards and reporting widgets are a fair axis for a project-management tool like Trello, but the evidence pack documents no dashboard or widget capability. The 'track progress… with a visual layout' line describes the board itself. The note that Power-Ups can 'give you a new view into the data' is a developer building block, not a documented reporting dashboard, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can build dashboards and widgets to report on project progress
